verifyNote: Unity Editor luon mo san; verify qua MCP server 'UnityMCP' (MCP for Unity, HTTP http://127.0.0.1:8081/mcp, khai bao trong .mcp.json). Compile: read_console action=clear -> refresh_unity mode=force compile=request wait_for_ready=true -> read_console types=[error,warning]; console phai 0 error/0 warning. validate_script de check mot file truoc khi refresh. Test: Unity Test Framework qua run_tests (EditMode moi lan verify; PlayMode khi brief yeu cau hoac --full) roi get_test_job; project chua co test asmdef thi bo buoc test. Khong chay dotnet build/npm test. Fallback khong co MCP: grep 'error CS|warning CS' trong %LOCALAPPDATA%/Unity/Editor/Editor.log.
